model_selection: No benchmark checkpoint tuning, training, or shadow-based selection.
noise: One deterministic balanced corpus noise variant per scene. Learned methods share full corpus rollout seed; official MMD uses its NumPy-compatible 32-bit reduction.
repair: Sparse, dense and unary proposals use the same injected-root MMD XECBS repair. Official MMD uses its native proposal and XECBS planning path.
size_decision: Predeclared after the 16-scene four-method smoke based on approximately 30, 31, 74 and 84 seconds per scene for sparse, dense, unary and MMD respectively. A 1024-scene four-method benchmark would exceed the practical runtime budget. The first 512 manifest scenes are fixed before full evaluation; size was not chosen from observed quality outcomes.
success: All 28 final goals within 0.05 m, zero sampled pair-time conflicts at distance <0.100 m, and no timeout.
timeouts: Retain each scene in the denominator and record timeout as final failure.
timing: Synchronized uninstrumented proposal and native planner wall time per scene. Separate CUDA-event replay used only for model-component attribution.
